name: codex-image-context-runtime
description: Context-bounded image generation and inspection through durable local jobs.

interface.longDescription: Generate and inspect images through durable local jobs that return bounded text receipts, hashes, references, and Job IDs instead of media payloads.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image as a durable job and return only its Job ID.
Inspect a workspace image and return a bounded text handoff.
